messages:
maya (product): Heads-up — big customer ask: Optimize recommendations for mobile/edge SDKs. They want batching + cache heuristics + 4-bit quantization guidance, plus eval-triggered alerts for regressions. Can we sketch a minimal launch plan for this?
liam (eng): Do we actually support 4-bit inference in the mobile runtime yet? last I checked we had int8 and fp16 shipping.
sam (ml): We have a research recipe for 4-bit (QLoRA-ish) that looks promising, but it needs KV-cache reshaping. Without aggressive eviction the prefix cache blows up on long chats.
olivia (devex): SDK implications: we'll need a small config surface: { prefer_quant: bool, cache_mode: [none|ttl|size], max_batch: int } and telemetry hooks for eval alerts. Can push a prototype by EOW if spec'd.
maya (product): Proposed launch criteria (alpha): 1) end-to-end p95 <= 150ms on a 1.5s prompt on representative mid-range devices, 2) quality delta <= 3% relative to baseline on our eval set, 3) eval-triggered alerting wired to the console for any >3% drop. Happy to relax numbers if infra says impossible.
liam (eng): 150ms p95 on-device is tough if we do batching. Maybe separate alpha tiers: emulator tests for perf, small beta with on-device instrumentation. Also need a safe fallback: if quant path misses quality gate, runtime auto-falls back to int8 variant.
sam (ml): Fallback policy sounds right. Also suggest we do two quant profiles: q4-fast (aggressive op fusion, lower quality) and q4-safe (slightly larger but better conv). ML team can validate on the customer's eval slices.
olivia (devex): For the eval-triggered alerts: we'll pipe eval metrics (concordance, token-level PPL, task-specific score) and let product set threshold rules. We should ship a default rule for the pilot: concordance drop >3% in 24h.
maya (product): Ops questions: what's the rollout path? feature-flagged, then customer opt-in, then automatic enforcement?
liam (eng): Suggest: feature flag + canary routing to quant pool -> if customer opts in send to quant pool; if alert fires rollback to stable pool and create incident. ops-bot can create the ticket automatically if alerts cross threshold.
ops-bot: Auto-action proposal: if eval-alert triggered twice in 6h for same model+customer -> create ticket and flip fallback flag.
analytics-bot: Note: we'll need per-customer baselines stored (time-windowed). This increases storage by ~5% per active tenant.
maya (product): Customer asks also mentioned local cache TTL control — they want short-lived cache for privacy. Need to expose cache_mode ttl and an explicit purge API.
olivia (devex): Purge API is straightforward: POST /sdk/v1/cache/purge { tenant_id, keys? } and we'll surface in Console. Need auth and rate limits.
sam (ml): One more risk: eval sets on-device are noisy. Recommend combining device telemetry with server-side evals for gating.
liam (eng): Implementation workstreams: runtime (quant kernels + fallback), cache (ttl + eviction), SDK (config + purge), observability (per-tenant baselines + alerting). Rough effort: 6w runtime, 3w cache, 2w SDK, 2w observability (some parallel).
maya (product): OK — prioritize runtime + observability first. Delivery target for alpha: 6 weeks. Can we get an engineering thumb? :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:?
liam (eng): :thumbsup: but need staffing commitment from infra for kernel work.
sam (ml): :thumbsup: ML will provide q4-safe and q4-fast profiles and a small eval harness.
olivia (devex): :thumbsup: will draft SDK surface and example config + docs.
maya (product): I'll draft acceptance checklist and customer pilot onboarding. Quick config example for docs (draft):
```json
{
  "prefer_quant": true,
  "quant_profile": "q4-safe",
  "cache_mode": "ttl",
  "cache_ttl_seconds": 30,
  "max_batch": 8,
  "eval_alert_rule": {
    "metric": "concordance",
    "window_hours": 24,
    "threshold_drop_pct": 3
  }
}
```
liam (eng): That helps. Add a note: "if fallback triggered -> record event, route requests to stable pool, and send customer notification".
maya (product): Great. I'll set up a customer pilot doc and invite the sales AE. Next: can we all sync Wed 10am for a 30m planning huddle?
sam (ml): Wed 10 works for me.
olivia (devex): Me too.
liam (eng): Booked.
ops-bot: Flag created: OPTIMIZE-EDGE-QUANT-477777 (owner: maya).
